There is a strip of nn cells, cell i𝑖 holds ai𝑎𝑖.

Find the maximum score:

∑

See the picture:

Input

The first line contains one integer t𝑡 (1≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The second line contains n integers (2≤n≤2⋅105).

Output

For each test case, print one integer — the maximum possible score.

Example
Input
Copy
2
6
3 5 1 4 3 2
LRLLLR
2
2 8
LR
Output
Copy
18
10
Note

In the first test case, choose l=1 first.
